idea-plugin.name: Advanced SEO Audit
idea-plugin.description:
Advanced SEO Audit for JetBrains IDEs

Professional technical SEO auditing, on-page diagnostics, crawler, Core Web Vitals inspection, and structured data validation directly inside your IDE.

Key Features

  • On-Page SEO Diagnostics: Missing or malformed title tags, meta descriptions, canonical URLs, robots meta directives, language tags, and heading hierarchy.
  • Technical SEO Analysis: HTTP status codes, redirect loops, canonicalization consistency, and HTTPS mixed content.
  • Structured Data & Schema.org: JSON-LD syntax validation, schema type verification (Article, Product, Organization, Breadcrumbs), and missing properties.
  • Performance & Core Web Vitals: Response time (TTFB), missing text compression, image lazy-loading, and CLS image dimension checks.
  • IDE Project Source Scanner: Audits HTML, PHP, JSX, TSX, Vue, Svelte, XML sitemaps, and robots.txt files in your project.
  • Website Crawler: Bounded, concurrent crawler with SSRF protection, robots.txt compliance, and progress cancellation.
  • Interactive Tool Window: Dynamic filtering by severity and category, instant preview of evidence and recommendations, and safe quick fixes.
  • Export Subsystem: Generates executive reports in HTML, JSON, CSV, and Markdown.
